outcome: laboratory abnormalities (thrombocytopenia, hyperkalemia, leukocytosis, hyperglycemia, hypoglycemia)
clinical adverse events (hypotension requiring pressors, necrotizing enterocolitis, death)
cohort: The study included 428 infants hospitalized in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) who received at least one dose of octreotide between 1997 and 2012.
finding: Relatively few adverse events occurred during the off-label use of octreotide in this cohort of hospitalized infants.
